agent.problem: The setup only says that the centurion saw how Jesus died and then spoke. It gives no basis for reasoning out “Son” rather than “Servant” or “Prophet,” so the baker can only guess the unseen wording of the centurion's line.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

agent.problem: The second sentence says these women knew Jesus earlier, back in the northern region where He started preaching. That relies on Mark 15:41, which says they had followed and ministered to Him in Galilee, but the card cites only Mark 15:40. Its citation is narrower than what the card tells.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
